column1: # The C return type of every `extern:"c"` function of stdlib/abla/runtime/platform/windows/entry.ab, and its width in bits (0: void).
# tools/test-windows-extern-widths.sh fails on a function missing here, and on one whose declared Abla type is wider than its C type:
# a 32-bit return (BOOL, DWORD, int, BOOLEAN) is declared i32 and widened at the use, because the x64 and ARM64 ABIs leave the upper half of
# the return register undefined (the Winsock -1 that read as 4294967295 was one: tests/cases/windows/socket-failure.ab).
